mechanism_defects.name: slack_effects_requires_public_users
mechanism_defects.what: slack_effects._scope(initial) requires a `users` collection in the public initial Slack state. Tasks whose public Slack declares only channels and messages (finance.xero_vendor_onboard) raise slack_collection_unavailable:users, so the slack.messages@1 inventory never closes: a correct thread reply still scores 1, but a missing, top-level or wrong-thread reply is unknown instead of 0 (coverage abstains on Luna and on every simulator run).
mechanism_defects.fix_sketch: Treat absent public Slack collections like the sparse-public reconciliation of mechanism 1 (public_service_matches already used for the boundary comparison): validate only collections present in the public initial state.

mechanism_defects.name: record_writes_requires_id_field
mechanism_defects.what: service.record_writes@1 (and final.records@1) require an `id` field on the collection model; every Xero collection is keyed by `<kind>_id` (contacts.contact_id, payments.payment_id, ...), so no Xero create/update/delete is observable. identity_paths cannot help: collection_shape rejects the collection before identity_paths are read, and identity_paths need 2-4 fields.
mechanism_defects.fix_sketch: Allow a reviewed single-field identity (identity_paths of length 1, e.g. [["contact_id"]]) for list collections without `id`, mirroring initial.records@1 which already accepts it.
